name: SafeBench
description: SafeBench is a safety evaluation framework for multimodal large language models, featuring a harmful query dataset and an automated jury deliberation evaluation protocol to reliably assess model safety across multiple modalities.
reputation: A newer safety benchmark for multimodal LLMs that is emerging in the literature, but it has not yet reached broad community adoption as a standard safety leaderboard.
notes: Includes 23 risk scenarios with multimodal harmful queries; introduces a novel evaluation protocol inspired by judicial jury deliberation.
